content.text:
I changed `gitDiff` in `packages/playwright/src/plugins/gitCommitInfoPlugin.ts` so it no longer turns a full clone into a shallow one on CI pull request builds. I couldn't build or run anything, so the change is untested.

The cause was that the base-commit fetch always passed `--depth=1`. That flag shallows a full clone.

Before fetching, the code now runs `git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository`. It adds `--depth=1` only if the repo is already shallow. A full clone gets a normal fetch of the base commit, so the diff is still captured and the clone stays complete.
